description: Amazon SageMaker model-registry metadata connector (Tier-3, no-row-data). Indexes ML-model REGISTRY metadata only — model name, ARN, primary-container image reference, model-data S3 URL (a pointer string, not the bytes), execution-role ARN, and creation time — via the AWS CLI's SageMaker list-models and describe-model commands. Never invokes an endpoint and never fetches inference data, training data, or model-artifact bytes: there is no sagemaker-runtime invoke-endpoint and no predict/query/records path. Reuses the existing AWS credentials via the aws CLI. Read-only; no write tools.
author: Nimbus
